description: CosimR is an R package published by the jywang2016 repository for preparing and running co-simulation between EnergyPlus and external R, Python or C/C++ programs through BCVTB. It copies, modifies and writes BCVTB XML configurations and can invoke a co-simulation through the command line. The README walks through a schedule example with an EnergyPlus building and weather file, showing simulation times, exchanged arrays and external-program settings. Public source is free under GPL-3.0. Coverage is the configured building and scenario; the example uses a one-day run, but duration and timestep are user inputs, not fixed observations. The implementation is deliberately minimal. Automatic variables.cfg generation and IDF-interface checking are listed as planned, so users must adjust external scripts and model interfaces themselves. The README also reports slower Rscript invocation than Python in its example. CosimR supports building-control and coupling experiments around the catalogue's EnergyPlus model (model-energyplus). It prepares the coupling configuration; numerical equivalence and time synchronisation were not tested during this review.
